title: His first arrangement for Basie: 'Baby Girl'
summary: He had been arranging since the Reno Club and wrote his first Basie piece, 'Baby Girl', for his niece Jackie.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: We're nearly finished, we'll just finish this side then we'll be more than half way.
Well now, were you arranging with Basie from the beginning or not?
I was arranging from the Reno Club. I started arranging ......
What were the earliest things you did?
Oh, I did mostly, mostly compositions that we'd make. Original stuff. I remember the very first number I made, it was called

Because my sister had just had a little baby girl. Her name is Jackie, she's in New York now. And I was so crazy about this, my little niece that I called the first number I made for Basie 'Baby Girl', for Jackie. And it was pretty good. A pretty good number.
